title: Overpriced and Not Good for Young Kids
text: Decided to give this a try because it was only $8.88, and my four year old loves to cook.  The box arrived and I was disappointed even at that price point.  The recipes weren’t good for young kids (raw ground pork?), and while there was some interesting information in the packet, it wasn’t anything you couldn’t find online.  The tongs were okay, and I suppose if we had something to collect the patches on that would be neat?  I cancelled before getting charged full price.
label: negative
